items.q: a guy named Chan that played trombone. So I told him about it

ctx.x: What's the name of this town?

Wewoka. It's nineteen miles east of Seminole. And I went down there, and I run into a guy named, like I said, J.R. Watts, the pianist. He had a little rhythm section, just a guitar and him and a drummer. And I told him, I said, I'd run into (what's his name?) A.J.
